Tooltip_QoLC_Lockpick: Thin enough to work a pin tumbler, with a screwdriver for tension.
Tooltip_QoLC_LockpickBook1: Teaches how to make a pick, and how to use one.
Tooltip_QoLC_LockpickBook2: Teaches how to lever a lock open with a crowbar.
Tooltip_QoLC_WorkbookCarpentry: Exercises to work through with a saw and a hammer. Costs planks, teaches carpentry.
Tooltip_QoLC_WorkbookElectrical: Exercises to work through with a screwdriver. Costs scrap electronics and wire, teaches electrical.
Tooltip_QoLC_WorkbookWelding: Exercises to work through with a torch and a mask. Costs scrap metal, teaches welding.
Tooltip_QoLC_WorkbookTailoring: Exercises to work through with scissors and a needle. Costs rags and thread, teaches tailoring.
Tooltip_QoLC_CorpseFlesh: Is there anything you would not do to survive? Eating this will make you very ill. It composts.
Tooltip_QoLC_PreparedCorpseFlesh: Trimmed and boned properly. Still a mistake to eat, and still a long way from food.
Tooltip_QoLC_CuringCorpseFlesh: Packed in salt. Leave it somewhere that is not cold for three days.
Tooltip_QoLC_CuredCorpseFlesh: Cured through. Raw, so cook it, and then it is meat like any other.
Tooltip_QoLC_ReadOnePage: Still too advanced to learn from, but reading a page is enough to recognise another copy later.
Tooltip_QoLC_ButcherCorpseNoKnife: Needs a sharp knife or a meat cleaver.
